name: What Roof Problems Can Delay a Home Sale?

mainEntity.name: What roofing issues delay home sales in Los Angeles County?
mainEntity.text: What roofing issues delay home sales in Los Angeles County?

acceptedAnswer.text: Roof issues can slow or complicate a home sale when buyers or inspectors find leaks, visible damage, missing documentation, or a roof that appears near the end of its service life. In Los Angeles County, buyers often pay close attention to roof age, patch history, attic moisture, and whether work was permitted when required. If a roof looks neglected or leaks are present, buyers may ask for a price reduction, repair credit, or replacement before closing. To reduce surprises, sellers often benefit from a pre-listing inspection and a clear record of past work. If repairs are needed, make sure the contractor provides documentation that can be shared during escrow. Even when a full replacement is not required, an organized roof file can improve buyer confidence and reduce negotiation friction.
acceptedAnswer.description: Roof leaks, missing permit records, poor workmanship, visible patching, and old roofs near end of life can delay a sale or trigger repair demands. Buyers often focus on roof age, water stains, and inspection findings. A pre-listing inspection can reduce surprises during escrow.
